title: Father and Child with Present, 1960s B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A heartwarming black-and-white square snapshot capturing a father and young child in a suburban living room setting, circa 1960. The father, wearing horn-rimmed glasses, cradles his child who is dressed in cozy pajamas and holding a small wrapped gift box. The room features distinctive mid-century modern aesthetic details, including a wooden side table with stacked magazines and a tall sculptural floor lamp with a textured shade.
